name: Slack Green tests
ownerWords: and how has the a/b tests going in general? what worked/didn't work? did anything work at all?  your duty is to check ab test results as they clear every day. NEVER CHANGE SHIT UNLESS PROVEN!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
goal: Every Slack Green A/B test gets its call on the day it clears, and nothing reaches all users unless its test proved it (c222). A test is live in PostHog project 226805 while its experiment has a start date and no end date; the call is recorded in PostHog as the experiment's end date and conclusion, so PostHog is the one record of calls. Its read date is a 'Read date: YYYY-MM-DD' line in the experiment description, else its read_date in ~/work/slack-green-ab-tests/tests.json, else 28 days after its start.

metrics.label: Slack Green tests past their read date with no recorded call
PostHog reads that failed in this check

onMiss: source_errors: fix the precheck or POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY in slack-green scripts/seo-agent/.env first. Then make one call for each overdue_test slice. Read the experiment's description for its primary metric and its PostHog results page for that metric; the slice's counts (first exposure, signup or connect within 7 days, paid within 28 days, QA people removed, the ab-results-page method) and Fisher p are a cross-check. won: the test arm beats control on the primary metric with p under 0.05, or at a read date set before launch PostHog shows the test arm at 95% or more chance to beat control. lost: the same proof with control ahead. flat: neither, which includes a test too small to tell; it ends on control. Record the call from the owner's us.posthog.com tab in Aside (page.evaluate fetch with X-CSRFToken from the posthog_csrftoken cookie): PATCH /api/projects/226805/experiments/<id>/ with end_date now, conclusion won, lost or inconclusive, and conclusion_comment as one line with the arms' numbers and p. Then apply it: lost or flat sets the flag to control at 100%, won sets the test arm to 100%, with PATCH /api/projects/226805/feature_flags/<flag id>/. Server-side tests in the slack-green proxy ignore the flag, so open one slack-green PR that removes the lost arm or keeps the won arm as the only path, run its scoped checks, merge it yourself with `bash <(git show origin/main:scripts/merge-pr.sh) <pr>` (c74 pre-approves merges until launch, c214), and walk the result on prod. Never put a merge on For you. Before a flat call, read the test's p_value in ~/work/slack-green-ab-tests/tests.json beside the slice: when either reading is under 0.05 and the test has no pre-set read date, do not end it; write a 'Read date:' line 14 days out in its description with the numbers and let it run. A test whose flag got no new exposure for 14 days or more lost its code path, so it cannot run on: record it with conclusion stopped_early and a comment naming the replacing change and both readings, and change nothing for users. A test may move its read date only when its description names a planned sample it has not reached: write a new 'Read date:' line with the reason, once per test. After a call, follow any 'Holdout after the read' note in that experiment's description: build and launch the 50/50 holdout it names, with its own experiment and a 'Read date:' line, unless the call shipped what the note says makes it moot. A tests.json test with no PostHog experiment gets an experiment named with its key, then the same call. Never change anything for all users without a won call, and never email users. Report each call in one short line, like 'sg-exp-x lost: control 4 of 106, test 1 of 111, p 0.2, flag back to control'. With nothing overdue, end with no message.
